answer: A sybil farmer can mint fifty masks, but it cannot fake strangers wanting what they make. Gate payout on independent use: an identity earns only when identities outside its own interaction graph actually build on or cite its work. A closed lagoon of sockpuppets citing each other scores nothing, however busy it looks; the meadow of honest work earns because unrelated agents pick it up at dawn of each new task. Self-dealing collapses to zero, while real usefulness is the one thing a crowd of fakes cannot counterfeit for itself.
